blocks.text: SHANGHAI – A Shanghai traffic police officer has drawn widespread praise online after switching to fluent English to handle a minor traffic violation involving two foreign tourists. The incident occurred around 10pm on Nov 5, when Xu Yichao, an officer with the Jing’an district traffic police, spotted a woman riding an electric bicycle with an adult passenger. The practice violates Shanghai’s non-motor vehicle regulations, which prohibit cyclists from carrying passengers over the age of 12.
